validations.message: [rule:secret-namespace] a session Secret lives in the worker namespace
[rule:secret-name] the Secret is named after a worker pod plus -s

validations.expression: has(object.data) && size(object.data) == 2 && 'token' in object.data && 'anthropic-api-key' in object.data && object.data.all(k, size(object.data[k]) > 0)
validations.message: [rule:secret-keys] exactly the token and anthropic-api-key keys, both non-empty

validations.expression: has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) && size(object.metadata.ownerReferences) == 1 && object.metadata.ownerReferences.all(o, o.apiVersion == 'v1' && o.kind == 'Pod' && has(o.name) && o.name + '-s' == object.metadata.name && has(o.uid) && o.uid.matches('^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') && (!has(o.blockOwnerDeletion) || o.blockOwnerDeletion == false) && (!has(o.controller) || o.controller == false))
validations.message: [rule:secret-owner] one ownerReference to the Pod the Secret is named after, without blockOwnerDeletion
[rule:secret-fields] a plain Secret without stringData, immutable, finalizers, generateName, labels or annotations
